question: How should a shrine be adorned with ornaments and other decorations?
premises: Shrines are adorned with all ornaments.
inference: The verse prescribes complete ornamentation of shrines using all and other ornaments.
uncertainties: Exact referent of dhāman as shrine or abode is uncertain.
samalaṃkṛtam may modify the shrine or the whole structure.
plain_english: Shrines are to be well decorated with all ornaments and other ornaments.
